coverage_notes: Completed 12 bounded targeted web searches covering only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss, disaster-related food-distribution cancellation, abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction, and official SNAP/WIC interruption. No new qualifying disruption was identified in the observation window. Fresh Hawaii recovery coverage was reviewed: Kauai reporting said North Shore Food Pantry distribution would proceed as scheduled, and Big Island reporting repeated the already-known Food Basket warehouse closure, so neither was retained as a new finding. Donation drives, resource guides, routine program promotion, generic inflation coverage, stale events, and duplicate/recycled reporting were excluded.
